author: Cinewright / original procedural authorship for this implementation
source: author.mjs; no third-party model, texture, animation or film image
pivot: each mesh local origin, grouped actor origin at floor contact
colorSpace: GLB has no textures; hatch atlas is generated linear data; material colors authored sRGB
alpha: GLB opaque; adapter transparent premultiplied canvas
rig: Rigid named node hierarchy, no skinning; no retargeting
rest: traveler upright at y=0, coat/case/hat; vessel bottom at y=0
uv: Three parametric UV; seams are intentional and may remain visible
